ten_axes.contour: Painted fish faces left, line layer faces right with circular body/triangular tail. Cat and bird retain drawn plush silhouettes and shaded contour texture; no identity redesign is authorized.
ten_axes.material: Painted fish body/fin texture conflicts with the flat raster eye/outline and flat UI shell/pearls. Cat/bird show plush shading; they are not newly classified as flat solely because they are PNGs.
ten_axes.palette: Whole-body multiplication tints authored eyes/shadows too; red fish becomes dark navy/brown while selected swatch is bright red. Cat/bird red changes all body/eye hue; detail swatch purple leaves actual preview unchanged.
ten_axes.light: Authored broad highlights become dark under multiplication; accent shimmer changes brightness/alpha independently of body. No new relighting is accepted.
ten_axes.perspective: Fish body is wide lateral left view, fin sheet contains separately authored pieces, flat line silhouette uses a different direction/projection. Cat/bird body/accent use matching portrait canvases.
ten_axes.scale: Fish body 1024x387 fits 590x223 at fit .576; fins985x1024 fit337x350 at .342; line400square fits350square at .875 in the same590x350 control. Cat/bird body/accent350high stay aligned, blank8x8 line scales43.75 without visible pixels.
ten_axes.contact: Detached fins are plainly below fish body and the fin-sheet dorsal is oversized. Kitty horn/belly and bird wing accents stay registered in sparse native stills; complete motion/downstream contact remains open.
ten_axes.occlusion: Flat line eye is a second large eye over painted body; UI shell crest overlaps the dorsal/head position for fish/cat/bird. Ambient particles/icons remain visible through overlay; no source retirement is claimed.
ten_axes.readability: Fish has two incompatible eyes, floating parts and dark red choice. Cat/bird have readable complete silhouettes but FINS and SWIM labels remain generic and glyph/UI control semantics require non-reader review.
ten_axes.action_state: Current actual GUI body/accent/third/rainbow/finish/private-save/reload/re-entry captured. Third value is saved only for cat/bird and not read by preview; no natural courtyard/battle/shop/species consumer or continuous motion/device/child/owner acceptance was exercised.

observations.repair_direction: Preserve all old saved values/flags and legitimate child coloring; define whole-unit color semantics rather than deleting controls or child designs.
